title: CoinTopper
tagline: CoinTopper is a SocialFi platform on Farcaster for crypto enthusiasts to engage in Q&A, bet on trends with its prediction frame, and connect via XMTP and Livepeer messaging or video, aiming to be the go-to crypto hub.
description: This project is a SocialFi platform on Farcaster, enabling crypto enthusiasts to engage in Q&A, bet on various trends and predictions with CoinTopper's prediction frame, and connect through messaging or video using XMTP and Livepeer, all with the aim of making CoinTopper a home for crypto enthusiasts.
how_its_made: Our project is a based on Next app, Typescript. Solidity language is used to write smart contract. Used Privy for user login and authentication, to create dynamic frame used Pinata FDK, to connect and interact with other crypto enthusiasts user can connect through XMTP and Livepeer, On Base we have deployed smart contract for Prediction betting frame and defi frame to stake borrow, lend on aave protocol and deployed contract on Optimism.
